reviews.title: Pretty good unless you have a dog that likes to chew.
reviews.body: Nothing wrong with them except they are lightweight.  Windstorm blew them away.  They held together fine with that but then my dogs got them.  They started unraveling in bits.  So good unless you have dogs that like to chew things..

reviews.title: Excellent product to redirect the rain
reviews.body: The extensions did not snug the downspout, but they worked just fine redirecting the rain.  The extender is so nice to direct the rain away from the house to the driveway.  I did not need to use the enclosed screws, but I'm glad they were included in case I decide at a later date to secure the extender.  I gave the item a five star because they do above and beyond what I expected.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026
reviews.author: Mimi

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.body: These are amazing. The fit is perfect and being able to put them together was exactly what I needed. The strength is amazing also. Not like the cheap ones at Home Depot. I just hope they will last awhile in the Colorado weather with the extreme heat and cold winters. We shall see. But in the meantime, I would highly recommend these.

features: Upgrade Design : This gutter downspout extensions comes with two lengths, 19 "can be extended to 58", 21" can be extended to 68". It comes with an auxiliary connectors, which helps you to connect two drainage pipes to reach the length you need, which will help you to solve the problem of damaged foundation, irrigating garden and so on

Thickened Material : This downspout extender is made of PE material, we thicken them to make it harder and sturdier than others. We've done thousands of load-bearing tests, and it can withstand at least 10 pounds without deformation. It is suitable for the complex environment outside your house. You can even bury it in the ground

Widely Used : This downspout extender comes with 2 different sizes of downspout adapters to be suitable for 2 x 3 inches, 3 x 3 inches, 3 x 4 inches, 3.5 x 4 inches downspout. To ensure that the drainage pipe can be better fixed to the downspout, we provide 8 nails to help you to secure the drainage pipe and prevent it from slipping off

Excellent Performances : It has excellent performances of flexibility, easy to bend, and easy to restore to its original shape with no creases or cracks. It is antifreeze explosion proof and can be used in bad weather, such as snowing, sun exposure, etc.

Packing list & Services : 2 x Rain drain pipes, 1 x Connector, 4 x Adapters, 8 x Screws (The screws will help you to hold the extender on downspouts to prevent the extender from being washed away by rain). And we will provide you with 100% satisfactory service and 24/7 responsive customer service
